3. Medical diagnosis using AI: Healthcare systems that utilize artificial intelligence for diagnosing diseases or medical conditions have shown to be more accurate and consistent than human doctors, leading to earlier detection and improved treatment outcomes.

4. Weather forecasting models: Machine learning algorithms used in weather forecasting are able to process vast amounts of data in real-time, predicting weather patterns with greater accuracy and precision than human meteorologists.

5. Online customer service chatbots: Chatbots powered by AI are often more efficient and responsive than human customer service representatives, providing instant assistance to users around the clock.
